title: Fix enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps not disabling customCodeCops in workspace compilation
summary: Workspace compilation now correctly disables custom code analyzers when enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps is false, preventing custom analyzer diagnostics from running against test apps.
key_points: CustomAnalyzers is now cleared along with Analyzers for test and BCPT test folders when enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps is false
Before, only the built-in cops were disabled and custom analyzer DLLs kept reporting on test apps
Workspace compilation now matches the documented setting and the classic Run-AlPipeline flow
Regular apps compile before the test branches, so clearing the shared build parameters there does not affect normal app compilation
Regression tests check that --customanalyzers is emitted only when custom analyzers are supplied
